ai_summary: Computer Age Management Services (CAMS) reported robust Q1 FY'27 results, demonstrating strong year-on-year growth in operating revenue (11.5%), EBITDA (18.3%), and PAT (17.3%), with expanded margins. This solid performance was driven by continued dominance in mutual fund services, outpacing industry growth in key metrics like AUM and SIP accounts, complemented by successful diversification into non-MF businesses such as CAMSPay and Alternatives. The accompanying cover letter indicates the presentation is a resubmission to rectify a typographical error in an earlier version, representing a minor administrative oversight rather than a material financial impact.
